_readme: Hand-maintained source for scripts/build-world-map.mjs. Facts rule (CLAUDE.md): a pin renders as verified only when verified=true. Set verified=true only after reading the venue on the event's own race site (public/data/past_races.json URLs; the race-site repos under _harvest/repos; the old f1tenth.org site repo) or the conference site; the 'source' field says where. Unverified pins render as hollow rings with a mono 'tbc' tag; never silently drop them. lat/lng 0,0 is a sentinel the chapter skips. Events are listed in CHRONOLOGICAL order and the chapter animates them in array order (upcoming last). number = the official 'Nth ... Grand Prix / Autonomous Racing Competition' from the race site title where it exists (ICRA 2026 = 27th, IV 2026 = 28th, IFAC 2026 = 29th, VTC 2026 = 30th, IROS 2026 = 31st); the chapter's competition ticker shows the numbered race entries only, so an entry without a number pops on the map but never enters the ticker. Numbers still open (2026-08-22, no written source found): 6th (nothing between Columbia 2019 and IFAC 2020 on any f1tenth.org capture), 13th (IV 2023 calls itself 'F1Tenth IV2023 Championship'), 16th (the Penn home race of April 29, 2024 is only a flyer image). kind: race | madgames | workshop | course. status: held | upcoming | virtual (virtual = the competition ran online, the pin sits on the nominal host city and renders hollow). labelDx/labelDy: optional map-label nudge in viewBox units from the pin (labelDx < 0 anchors the text end on the left, labelDx 0 centers it); without them the chapter places labels greedily and drops the ones that would overlap. countries: partner / team countries for phase 1 (why = the page the affiliation was read from). Verified 2026-08-21 (builder C). Re-verified 2026-08-22 against the race sites (docs/EVENTS_VERIFICATION.md): the github.com/f1tenth/<conf><year>_race repos are private, so the GitHub Pages sites they publish and the old f1tenth.org site at f1tenth.github.io were read instead; iros2021 status changed virtual -> held on the strength of its in-person results page. url / url_status / url_note (added 2026-08-23, pages v1): the event's own page. url_status is live | archive | none. live = the URL answered 200 on 2026-08-23; archive = the original domain is dead and the URL is a Wayback capture, which the race page tags visibly; none = no page ever existed and the timeline renders the entry as unlinked text. Never leave a dead anchor: re-check with the link checker before changing a status.
